_comment: surface_xyz for kitchen_table/side_table_02/shelf_02 and persons.kitchen/persons.living_room are exactly the poses already spawned in gpsr-rcw2026-bench.json (soup, banana, bowl, kitchen_person, livingroom_person). The other four spot surfaces (side_table, laundry_desk, shelf, sofa) were measured 2026-08-29 from the built rcw2026 arena USD (artifacts/asset-manifest.json['generated_arena_usds'][0]['path'], or any artifacts/arena/rcw2026/*/arena.usd -- two independently-built copies gave identical furniture placements) using `uv run --frozen --no-sync python` (pxr is present in this repo's own uv-managed venv; see tools/tinker_sim_deploy/cli.py's _launch_command for this invocation pattern) to read /World/Arena/Furniture/rcw26_<spot> prim world-space origin xy (UsdGeom.Xformable.ComputeLocalToWorldTransform) and world bounding-box max z (UsdGeom.BBoxCache.ComputeWorldBound). side_table reuses side_table_02's known surface z (0.612) since both are the same furniture asset and their raw bbox tops match almost exactly (0.6025 vs 0.6025); shelf reuses shelf_02's known usable-shelf-level z (1.07) for the same reason (both bbox tops are 2.0196, the top of the whole multi-level unit, not a usable shelf surface); laundry_desk uses its own bbox top directly (0.7337, rounds to 0.734, within 1cm of kitchen_table's own known desk height); sofa uses the design doc's flat seat-height fallback (0.45) since its bbox top (0.653) is the backrest, not the seat. Person poses for bedroom/laundry_room use the design doc's exact fallback formula (no analogous already-spawned ground truth for these two rooms): DEC constants.rcw2026.json possible_poses[<room's first search_spots entry>] point, moved 0.8m along that pose's own facing direction (yaw = 2*atan2(orientation.z, orientation.w)), z=0, with the person's own orientation rotated 180 degrees from the spot's yaw so they face back toward the spot.
_extents_comment: surface_bbox_xy ([[xmin, ymin], [xmax, ymax]], world frame) and half_extent_xy are the furniture's measured world bounding box from simulation/scenarios/rcw2026-pose-audit.json (tools/gpsr_pose_audit.py over the built arena USD, 2026-09-27); for the two open shelves the back panel (4.5 cm, against the wall) is excluded from the bbox so nothing is placed into it. tools/gpsr_scene.SurfaceLayout keeps every spawned object's footprint inside surface_bbox_xy minus a 4 cm edge margin (fix4 run 3: the old (i % 3) * grid_dx grid marched cmd_soup_0 off side_table_02 onto the floor). grid_dx/grid_dy are kept only as the legacy fallback for a spot without surface_bbox_xy and as tools/gpsr_run_truth_probe.py's last-resort extent.
_persons_comment: Recomputed 2026-09-30 (fix5 run 002: the bedroom person at [0.28, 1.755] stood inside side_table_02 and was knocked over; laundry_room's was inside laundry_desk, living_room's behind wall_0003, kitchen's was too close to chair_02). The kitchen pose was moved to [1.85, -1.55] after the measured kitchen-table search anchor moved on 2026-10-07; it is now 1.71 m from that anchor, has clear line of sight, and clears furniture by 0.39 m. Rule, enforced offline by tests/test_gpsr_person_placements.py against rcw2026-pose-audit.json furniture/walls bboxes: the person_standing collision box (config/person-import.json) is >= 0.30 m from every furniture/wall bbox and the union of every allowlisted person asset's box (sitting/gesture assets use the same pose) >= 0.15 m; everything inside its room quadrant; 1.2-2.5 m from the room's first search_spots pose (where goto(room) lands) with a line of sight clear of walls and of furniture >= 0.8 m tall; the model faces its own -y, so yaw = atan2(dx, -dy) toward the spot. The +/-60 deg-of-heading target was infeasible for laundry_room/living_room/bedroom (each spot faces furniture against a wall 0.5-1 m ahead), so those sit at 77-89 deg off the spot heading, inside the pan +/-45 deg + half-FOV 45 deg envelope but near its edge. `lying` is the free-floor pose (>= 0.30 m clearance for the whole 0.55 x 1.91 m body, centre in view) that gpsr_scene.lying_pose uses instead of laying the body out behind the upright pose; living_room has none because a lying person there lies on the sofa (its search spot).
_operator_comment: Added 2026-10-01 (fix8 run s70718-000: 'bring me a soup' -- no person stood at the command point, the robot found the living-room person 2.9 m away and the approach aborted). The operator who gave the command stands 1.0 m in front of the command point (-2.0, -2.0, facing +x), facing the robot. tools/gpsr_scene.plan_scene spawns them for commands addressed to 'me'; tests/test_gpsr_person_placements.py checks clearance (0.645 m to wall_0007).
